Application Data.NAME: Artisan Studio Collective
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Artisan studio and gallery offering craft workshops, showcasing local artists, and hosting community events. Focusing on creative expression while ensuring safety and risk management in all operations.
Application Data.GENERAL INFO QUESTIONS:
1. No - The operations do not involve hazardous materials as they focus on art and crafts, which typically do not include hazardous substances.
2. No - The business does not sponsor athletic teams; it is solely focused on arts and crafts.
3. Yes - Sub-contractors are required to provide a certificate of insurance, and the owner personally checks all certificates to ensure compliance.
4. No - The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any crimes related to fraud or arson.
5. No - There have been no policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years.
6. No - The business does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff are direct hires.
7. Yes - Workers' Compensation insurance is carried to cover employee injuries.
8. No - The business does not own or operate any other business; it is exclusively focused on the arts and crafts arena.
9. No - There are no other insurance policies with this company.
10. No - The business is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; all works are original creations.
11. No - The business does not rent or loan equipment to others; all equipment is used exclusively for in-house activities.
12. No - The applicant has not experienced a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years.
13. No - There is no exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as the business does not engage in activities that pose such risks.
14. No - There is no catastrophe exposure as defined by the services provided.
15. No - There are no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse, discrimination, or negligent hiring; the business maintains a respectful environment.
16. No - There are no uncorrected fire code violations; the business complies with all safety regulations.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 03/15/2023; Cause: Water damage from a burst pipe; Amount: $1,200.00; Status: Closed
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and 24-hour video surveillance system.

The instructors seemed unprepared and were unable to adequately address questions about the class materials, making it difficult to fully engage in the creative process. Additionally, I couldn't help but wonder how well they manage important aspects like equipment breakdown and employee honesty, as the space felt disorganized and chaotic, raising concerns about the overall safety and quality of the environment.
